messages.subject: Abundance estimate
parts:
Dear All, forgive me if this is a novice's question, but I am a novice.
If I have 82 observations of zebra in plains habitat, and 4 observations
in Acacia habitat, and have specified the area for both, why does DISTANCE
report a value for N (which I understand to be abundance) as zero, when I
recorded a total of over 500 animals in the area. Also based on minimum
AIC the model selected for plains habitat was negative exponential even
though p = 1.000 for the transect, surely the uniform model would have
been more appropriate. Many thanks justine Shelley
